s.t:
Join a team dedicated to delivering an exceptional customer experience. In this role, you will provide direct support to policyholders, producers, providers, and other stakeholders through phone, email, and written correspondence. You will resolve customer inquiries, process complex transactions, and manage a variety of service requests with professionalism and efficiency.
Successful candidates will demonstrate strong customer service skills, the ability to analyze and process multifaceted requests, and the confidence to work independently with minimal supervision. This position offers the opportunity to develop an expanded knowledge base while contributing to a collaborative, engaged, and accountable workforce focused on customer satisfaction and operational excellence.

Hourly Wage: $21.00, plus annual bonus opportunity.
401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

Deliver exceptional customer service by handling inquiries, resolving issues, and communicating outcomes through phone, email, and written correspondence while supporting customer retention.
Meet performance expectations for customer satisfaction, quality, productivity, attendance, and schedule adherence in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.
Analyze and process complex policy transactions, make informed decisions, manage financial-impacting requests, and identify opportunities to retain and grow business.
Collaborate effectively with customers, providers, producers, and internal partners to resolve issues, share knowledge, support team development, and improve processes.
Demonstrate accountability, adaptability, and continuous learning by staying current on products, procedures, regulations, and industry changes while proactively contributing to operational excellence.

Proven experience with the Health product line
Proven experience working in the Health Call Center
Demonstrate accountability, professionalism, and a strong sense of urgency while adhering to company policies, performance expectations, and attendance requirements.
Provide exceptional customer service through active listening, effective communication, empathy, and timely resolution of customer inquiries and concerns.
Successfully manage high-volume phone interactions while multitasking across multiple systems, applying product knowledge, and maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
Utilize strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills to make informed decisions, manage priorities, collaborate effectively, and continuously improve through feedback and learning.
You promote a collaborative culture, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.
Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States or Puerto Rico.

Seasoned Health service call center skills and knowledge.
Willingness to be on camera to actively participate in daily team huddles.
Experience with the application of policies, practices and procedures in a business environment.
Broad insurance product knowledge.

Serves as a technical advisor. Manages and accounts for equipment assets and activities. Oversees and evaluates the EOD Flight's training program. Oversees flight EOD training needs outlined in the Career Field Education and Training Program (CFETP) and base support requirements in accordance with Air Force instructions/directives. Manages munitions activity. Ensures proper forecasting and accounting of ground demolition munitions requirements.
In order to qualify, you must meet the requirements described in the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Qualification Standards for General Schedule Positions, Administration and Management Positions.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Applicants must have at least one (1) year of specialized experience at the next lower grade GS-07, or equivalent in other pay systems.

Examples of specialized experience include knowledge of mobility and war readiness concepts, methodology, requirements, and operating principles and how they apply to the EOD Flight and the mission of the Wing.

Knowledge of EOD equipment and supplies including forecasting requirements; maintenance procedures and operational checks of EOD robotics, tools, and protective equipment; explosives handling and safety, proper storage, and security.

Knowledge of training program relationships and training systems to insure proficiency and other mandatory training of flight members is kept current. Knowledge of quality assurance, analytical, and evaluative methods and techniques.

OR EDUCATION: Master's or equivalent graduate degree or 2 full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree or LL.B. or J.D., in a field which demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to perform the work of the position. NOTE: You must submit a copy of Transcripts.

OR COMBINATION OF EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION: A combination of education and experience may be used to qualify for this position as long as the computed percentage of the requirements is at least 100%. NOTE: You must submit a copy of your transcripts.

FEDERAL TIME-IN-GRADE (TIG) REQUIREMENT FOR GENERAL SCHEDULE (GS) POSITIONS: Merit promotion applicants must meet applicable time-in-grade requirements to be considered eligible. One year at the GS-07 level is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-09 level.

TIG applies if you are in a current GS position or held a GS position within the previous 52 weeks. NOTE: Applicants applying as VEOA candidates who are current GS civil service employees or are prior GS civil service employees within the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSAs): Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: 1. Knowledge of all aspects of an operational EOD Flight with emphasis on EOD/munitions training, equipment, and supply to insure readiness. 2.

Knowledge of laws, regulations, policies, procedures, techniques, and methods to oversee activities for assigned specializations and functions. 3. Knowledge of the hazards associated with explosive and munitions, proper handling and standard storage, and hazardous classifications. 4.

Skill in developing training programs and conducting training and testing; written and oral communication as demonstrated in the application and interpretation of applicable instructions and similar documents used in the preparation of training materials and conducting training classes and/or briefings. 5.

Ability to plan and organize work, analyze problems, develop economical solutions autonomously and timely in a team setting, and maintain good working relations. 6. Ability to use office automation tools and techniques to retrieve, design, and generate reports, briefing materials, and other documents.

PART-TIME OR UNPAID EXPERIENCE: Credit will be given for appropriate unpaid and or part-time work. You must clearly identify the duties and responsibilities in each position held and the total number of hours per week.

VOLUNTEER WORK EXPERIENCE: Refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service Programs (i.e., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student and social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge and skills that can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

How to Prepare for the Recruiting Process -
📢 Why Are They Hiring an Insurance Customer Service Representative?
Our client is on a mission to bring calm to the chaos of commercial insurance—and they need a rockstar Customer Service Representative to help make that happen.

As their client base grows, so does the need for someone who can keep everything organized and on track: answering calls, replying to emails, processing billing and certificates, managing policy updates, and making sure renewals don’t slip through the cracks.

The team is lean, experienced, and high-performing—but they’re ready to hand off the operational load so they can stay focused on what matters.
This is your chance to be the backbone of the operation—bringing order, accuracy, and a personal touch to a team that truly values great service. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and love being the calm in the storm, this is where you belong. 🚀

Strong working knowledge of insurance operations, particularly in commercial lines
Familiarity with insurance terminology, policy documents, and servicing workflows
Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to handle client interactions professionally
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment
Experience or exposure to construction or contractor insurance is a HUGE plus!
Ideally using Apple products (Mac, iPhone) and are fluent in tools like Numbers, Pages, and iMessage for seamless collaboration.
Responsibilities of the Insurance Customer Service Representative:

📞 Client Communication & Frontline Support
Serve as the first point of contact by answering inbound calls on the agency's main line; this may also include making outbound follow-up calls when necessary
Handle approximately 17–20 phone calls per day, ranging from quickinquiries to more in-depth conversations
Monitor and manage the shared service inbox, which is color-coded and collaboratively used by multiple team members
Triage, flag, and forward incoming emails appropriately; long-term expectation is for the Insurance CSR to assess incoming correspondence, identify required actions, and assign or tag tasks independently
Draft and send welcome emails to new clients
Retrieve and forward necessary documents from insurance carriers to internal service staff
Respond to client requests for Certificates of Insurance (COIs), additional insured endorsements, and proofs of insurance, ensuring accuracy and compliance
🛠️ Policy Servicing & Endorsements
Process a wide range of policy changes, including updates to addresses, names, business entities, or ownership structures
Submit, track, and follow up on endorsements and miscellaneous changes, working closely with carriers and internal stakeholders
Request and issue required auto filings as needed for commercial clients

Manage updates to commercial auto policies, including the addition or removal of drivers and vehicles.
Ensure all vehicle schedules are updated accurately in Veruna
💳 Billing, Payments & Compliance
Accept and process direct bill payments with the highest level of discretion, compliance, and data security
Maintain accurate logs of all financial transactions in the CRM and related systems
Generate and send invoices via email and DocuSign one to two times per week
Manage and process renewal invoices, confirmations, and direct bill (DB) cancellations
Maintain organized logs for login credentials, endorsements, renewals, and cancellations
🔁 Renewal Tracking & Support
Track and monitor upcoming renewals, particularly for direct bill or automatic policy renewals.
Record and update renewal details—including effective dates and premiums—into the CRM system
Upload and organize renewal documents (e.g., declarations pages, binders, ID cards) into both Veruna and Google Drive
Communicate renewal statuses to clients and support retention efforts through proactive follow-ups
Update certificate templates, contractor license boards (e.g., for Workers’ Comp policies), and internal spreadsheets to reflect current policy information
Coordinate with carriers such as Guard, Progressive, and Mercury to obtain renewal documents and ensure completeness of files.
🗂️ Data Management & Documentation
Collect and consolidate data from multiple insurance policies for processing and documentation
Upload endorsements and supporting documents into Veruna and Google Drive with precision and consistency
Regularly clean up and organize folders by archiving outdated certificates and ensuring file structures are up to date
Assist in the creation, maintenance, and refinement of internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) related to service and policy workflows
🏡 Want to Know More About the Client?
Our client is a modern-day trailblazer in the world of commercial insurance, serving contractors and small-to-medium businesses for over a decade across California, Arizona, Nevada, Texas, and beyond.

With a laser-sharp focus on compliance, renewals, and risk management, they’ve built their reputation on delivering boutique-style service with big-league results. From the high-stakes world of construction coverage to personalized risk consultancy, this lean, powerhouse agency brings clarity and confidence to its clients' insurance decisions.
Their mission? To simplify the complex, protect what matters, and scale smartly—without ever losing their human touch. Their remote team is tight-knit, upbeat, and motivated by one simple rule: take care of the customer, take care of each other, and take pride in your day’s work. 🌟

Au sein de l'équipe Customer Care (Service Client), votre objectif est de maximiser la satisfaction client. Vous êtes le point de contact principal des clients tout au long de leur parcours, depuis le jour de leur réservation jusqu'au remboursement de leur dépôt de garantie après leur départ.

Vous assistez les clients pour l'ensemble de leurs problématiques, qu'elles soient administratives ou financières, y compris pour la maintenance de leur appartement. La maîtrise des langues est essentielle, car une part importante de nos clients est internationale.

La majorité de l'équipe est basée à Lyon, à l'exception d'une personne basée à Paris, et nous opérons à distance sur l'ensemble de nos villes en France.

Gérer la relation et accompagner le client à distance via Zendesk tout au long de son expérience de coliving, de l'entrée à la sortie du logement : rédaction du bail, vérification des documents, organisation des états des lieux d'entrée ( check-in ) et de sortie ( check-out ), comparaison des états des lieux, remboursement des dépôts de garantie.
Créer le dossier client numérique et le mettre à jour tout au long de son parcours.
Gérer à distance les conflits entre colivers (colocataires) et les litiges clients, dans le meilleur intérêt de l'entreprise et du client.
Recouvrer les impayés de loyers et les différents frais auprès des clients par e-mail et par téléphone.
Résoudre les problèmes techniques (paiement, accès au compte client, etc.) rencontrés par le client en mobilisant les ressources de l'entreprise.

Genau deshalb haben wir iwoca gegründet. Unsere smarte Technologie, moderne Datenanalyse und unser erstklassiger Kundenservice sorgen dafür, dass Unternehmer*innen schnell, sicher und kontrolliert handeln können - genau in den Momenten, in denen es darauf ankommt.
Wir haben bereits mehr als 150.000 Unternehmen mit über 4,5 Milliarden Euro unterstützt. Unser Team setzt alles daran, noch mehr Mittelständler*innen zum Erfolg zu verhelfen - durch besseren Zugang zu Finanzierung und zusätzliche Services, die den Geschäftsalltag einfacher machen. Unsere Mission?

Eine Million Unternehmen in ihren entscheidenden Momenten zu unterstützen und so einen nachhaltigen Beitrag zu leisten- sowohl für die Unternehmen selbst, als auch für ihr wirtschaftliches Ökosystem und die deutsche Gesamtwirtschaft.

Die Anforderungen

Zeigt Neugier im Umgang mit KI-Tools und Interesse daran, diese weiter zu erlernen. Du beantwortest Fragen zu unseren Produkten, dem Antragsprozess und iwoca allgemein und unterstützt so Neu- und Bestandskund*innen.
Du hilfst Unternehmen, ihren Antrag auszufüllen und die notwendigen Dokumente bereitzustellen, die wir für eine Kreditentscheidung benötigen.
Du arbeitest mit verschiedenen Teams innerhalb von iwoca zusammen, um das beste Ergebnis für unsere Kund*innen zu erzielen.

Unser Bereich Customer Support & Academy bildet die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Finnova, unseren Kunden und Partnern. Als Teil unseres engagierten Customer-Support-Teams arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Banking und IT und eng mit verschiedenen Fach- und Entwicklungsteams sowie unseren Partnern zusammen. ## Du begeisterst dich für... ##
* den direkten Kontakt mit unseren **Kunden und Partnern** und unterstützt sie als zentrale Anlaufstelle bei Fragen rund um unsere Produkte und das Extranet
* die **Triage und Qualitätsprüfung von Support-Tickets** und stellst sicher, dass diese vollständig und an die richtigen Stellen weitergeleitet werden
* die Unterstützung unserer Kunden und internen Stellen bei der **Nutzung unseres Ticketing-Tools**
* die Erstellung von **Reports, Auswertungen und kundenspezifischen Dashboards und** das Aufsetzen und Verwalten von **Benutzern und Berechtigungen** für unsere verschiedenen Plattformen
* die Koordination und Nachverfolgung von Kundenanliegen über verschiedene interne und externe Schnittstellen hinweg
* das Unterstützen bei der Administration und Durchführung unserer Academy Kurse für Kunden und Partner
* die aktive Mitarbeit bei der **Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Support-Prozesse und Services**
## Du begeisterst uns... ##
* mit deiner **IT-Affinität** oder ersten Erfahrungen im IT-Umfeld - die Position eignet sich auch für motivierte Quereinsteigerinnen und Quereinsteiger
* wenn du gerne mit **Kunden und Partnern** arbeitest und ein ausgeprägtes Serviceverständnis mitbringst
* wenn du Interesse an **Banking, Software und digitalen Services** hast - Kenntnisse im Bankenumfeld sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung
* wenn du dich schnell in neue **Tools, Prozesse und fachliche Themen** einarbeiten kannst
* wenn du strukturiert arbeitest, den Überblick behältst und auch bei mehreren parallelen Anfragen die richtigen Prioritäten setzt
* wenn du dich mündlich und schriftlich **klar und professionell auf Deutsch** ausdrücken kannst (mind. C1); Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
